tips_en: Read the Multiscale Policy Optimization paper first: its turn-level macro-action framing and local token correction directly address long-horizon agent credit assignment, with strong gains across nine search, tool-use, and automation metrics, though the single-run ablations warrant caution. It also connects conceptually to DTCA, which tackles token-level credit assignment in diffusion LMs, while ChronoReplay offers a complementary lesson about preserving multiple interfaces and valid temporal supervision.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读多尺度策略优化（MPO）论文：其回合级宏动作框架与局部 token 校正直接针对长程智能体的信用分配问题，并在搜索、工具使用和自动化的九项指标上取得全面优势，但消融实验仅单次运行，结论需谨慎解读。该论文与 DTCA 在扩散语言模型的 token 级信用分配上形成概念连接；ChronoReplay 则补充了保持多接口能力和使用有效时间监督的另一种思路。
